headline: HOU @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.26 at MIN 4.32, with a projected total of 8.58. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (HOU -0.27, MIN -0.13), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Kendry Rojas has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.7 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Braden Shewmake, Ryan Jeffers, Trevor Larnach, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cam Smith, Christian Vázquez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
